our_interpretation: The claim concerns the six named models in the original March 2025 evaluation.
Overall means the aggregate expert-assigned points, averaged across evaluation runs and divided by the maximum possible points. It does not mean the percentage of problems completely solved.
Later models and later evaluations are outside this claim.
criteria.support_condition: Every named model received an aggregate average score no greater than 5% of the available points in the original evaluation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one named model received an aggregate average score greater than 5% in that evaluation.
